{
  "question": "For Arden Central Bank, what do the latest records show about reserve drain? Please resolve this specific point: The September net reserve withdrawal after adding maturities and new allotments on the same settlement basis.",
  "gap": "The September net reserve withdrawal after adding maturities and new allotments on the same settlement basis.",
  "passages": [
    "I treated the announcement as a starting point and followed the measurement boundary through the reporting period.

Arden's operation ledger shows 18 billion in September maturities and 11 billion in replacement allotments; net withdrawal was 7 billion on settlement dates.

Background to the observation: Arden shortened the term of its reserve operations in September.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
